chapter_title_en: The Great Millstone of Heaven and Earth
chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Chapter 445: The Corpse's Might and a Century and a Half Lost
chapter_meta_description: The mysterious corpse defeats the Great Power Dark Sovereign, extracting Ancestral God essence. After 150 years trapped in gray mist, the survivors escape to find Yingxiong's kingdom destroyed and time has marched on.
og_title: Chapter 445: The Corpse's Strike and the Passage of a Century
og_description: A half-ancestor falls before the corpse's power. Seven survivors break free from a 150-year imprisonment in the Death World's gray mist. The world they knew is gone.
twitter_description: The Dark Sovereign is crushed. The group escapes the gray mist after a century and a half. Yingxiong's kingdom is dust. The Death World arc reaches a tragic turning point.
